//: The backend functions that thin data to draw it (decimators), and every backend function that computes with thinned points (readers) with what it does with them. Read by scripts/check_decimation_flow.py and src/test/plotContracts/values.ts. See docs/plot-contracts-guide.md ("Reading thinned points in the backend").

python-backend/analyzer.py:build_wavefor.why: thins the lanes' samples to draw them (decimated_waveform); the readout reads the full samples (track-waveform)

python-backend/analyzer.py:min_max_spect.why: cuts a spectrum row to its drawn buckets (min_max_rows); its range is every bin's, taken before

python-backend/stage_combine.py:_image.why: reduces a combined picture's cells to draw them (_signed_peaks); its colour range is the full cells' (with_value_range)

python-backend/stage_combine.py:_line.why: thins a combined line to draw it; its range, level bins and Δ peak are of the full data (with_value_range, with_level_bins, difference_peak)

python-backend/stage_combine.py:_signal_.why: picks the samples of a combined signal to draw (min_max_indices); its readout reads the full samples

python-backend/stage_combine.py:differen.why: a difference's drawn buckets (min_max_line); its headline's peak is of the full difference (difference_peak)

python-backend/stage_combine.py:draw.why: a combined picture as drawn (samples_waveform of the full samples); every number of it is of the full data

python-backend/stage_view.py:_cepstral_v.why: draws a cepstrum's envelope; its readout reads the full coefficients

python-backend/stage_view.py:_cepstrogra.why: reduces a cepstrogram's cells to draw them; its colour range is every full cell's

python-backend/stage_view.py:_channel_vi.why: draws a series over time as its envelope; its readout and range are of the full series

python-backend/stage_view.py:_correlatio.why: draws a correlation's envelope; its readout reads the full lags

python-backend/stage_view.py:_detail_vie.why: draws the part on screen again finer; every number is read from the full data (full_read)

python-backend/decimator.py:decimated_wa.why: the lanes' waveform: the samples bucket_extremes picks, each with its place in the file

python-backend/stage_view.py:_envelope_i.why: which values of a line are drawn (min_max_indices), as indices

python-backend/stage_view.py:_events_vie.why: draws each event's line and their mean as envelopes; the readout reads each event's full samples

python-backend/stage_view.py:_roughness_.why: averages roughness cells per time block to draw them; its colour range is every full cell's

python-backend/stage_view.py:_spectral_v.why: draws a spectrum line (spectrum_line); its readout and range are of every bin

python-backend/stage_view.py:signal_line.why: picks the samples of a signal to draw (_envelope_indices), each at its own time (x_at); its readout reads the full samples

python-backend/stage_view.py:samples_wav.why: a waveform's drawn envelope; its absolute peak is of the samples it is given, whole

python-backend/analysis_service.py:spect.why: cuts the row to draw it (min_max_spectrum); minDb / maxDb are every bin's, taken before (cursor-spectrum.range)

python-backend/analyzer.py:_build_spectr.why: resamples the cells to draw them; minDb / maxDb are every full cell's, taken before (track-spectrogram.range)

python-backend/stage_combine.py:_band_pe.why: thins a difference image's rows to its bands (each band's largest magnitude) to draw it; the headline peak is of the full difference

python-backend/stage_combine.py:_signifi.why: rounds the drawn difference values to significant figures to send them; computes no number of its own

python-backend/stage_view.py:_linear_ext.why: picks each bucket's lowest and highest index (min_max_indices on a linear axis) to draw a line; positions, not a value

python-backend/stage_view.py:band_levels.why: power-averages a picture's bins into its drawn bands; handed full levels it is the scan's band levels, handed drawn cells only a picture

python-backend/stage_view.py:floored_db.why: floors levels at MIN_LEVEL_DB; drawn points stay drawn points

python-backend/stage_view.py:power_mean_.why: power-averages levels along an axis (a block or a band of a picture); along an axis it still makes the picture

python-backend/stage_view.py:_spectrogra.why: power-averages the cells per time block to draw them; the colour range is every full cell's (valueRange, compare-overlay.range-image)

python-backend/scan_service.py:measure.why: a scan's 192-point spectrum, to draw (log_spectrum); every level, median and Δ is of every Welch bin (spectrumBinsDb) or the scan's own band levels

unthinned//: Places where a value that came from no decimator above is put in a field the protocol names as an array of drawn points (x-drawn), each with why nothing there is thinned. scripts/check_decimation_flow.py fails on a place not listed here: register a new thinning function under decimators instead of listing its caller.

unthinned.python-backend/full_read.py:read_line#va: a full read's points (StagePoints.values, x-whole): every value around the pointer, none thinned
unthinned.python-backend/full_read.py:_seek_line#v: a full read's points found by seeking to the next value (StagePoints.values, x-whole): none thinned
unthinned.python-backend/full_read.py:read_cells#m: a full read's cells (StagePoints.matrix, x-whole): every cell around the pointer, none thinned
unthinned.python-backend/stage_view.py:_noct_view#: a band table: every band of the NOctFrame is sent, none thinned; still x-drawn (StageView.values is a picture), so the webview reads the bars through the full read of the step (stageReader), never from these values
unthinned.python-backend/stage_combine.py:value_ra: one number, the lowest of every value before thinning (valueRange.min): not the envelope's array of the same name
one number, the highest of every value before thinning (valueRange.max): not the envelope's array of the same name
unthinned.python-backend/stage_combine.py:_line_bu: a table of how many points each kind of picture draws, keyed by the picture's mode: not a picture's events
